# Auth, Tenancy & Performance Requirements Quality Checklist: Flora Seed v0.1 Core Features

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for authentication, multi-tenancy isolation, and performance before implementation
**Created**: 2026-08-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Multi-Tenancy Isolation Requirements

- [x] CHK001 - Are data isolation requirements between organizations explicitly defined at the data access layer (not just access control)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK002 - Is tenant isolation enforced consistently across all entity types (messages, tasks, files, channels, search indices), or are exceptions documented? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006 to §FR-012]
- [x] CHK003 - Are cross-organization access prevention requirements defined for shared infrastructure (search, notifications, real-time streams)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK004 - Is workspace isolation within an organization specified with the same rigor as organization-level isolation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for preventing data leakage via global search across organization boundaries? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK006 - Are resource quota requirements (per-organization and per-workspace) specified for file storage and user counts? [Completeness, Gap]

## Authentication & OIDC Requirements

- [x] CHK007 - Are session lifecycle requirements (creation, duration, renewal, termination) explicitly defined for OIDC authentication? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK008 - Is the behavior specified when the OIDC provider (Zitadel) is unavailable during authentication or token validation? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK009 - Are logout requirements defined, including local session termination, OIDC session revocation, and single logout behavior? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK010 - Are token refresh requirements specified (automatic vs. manual, expiry grace periods, concurrent session handling)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK011 - Are fallback authentication mechanisms defined if OIDC integration fails or is misconfigured? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK012 - Are role-permission mapping requirements from OIDC claims to Flora roles explicitly defined with examples? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK013 - Are requirements for handling expired or revoked OIDC tokens during active user sessions specified? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK014 - Are rate limiting requirements for authentication endpoints (login, refresh, invite acceptance) quantified? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK015 - Are MFA/2FA requirements specified or explicitly excluded for v0.1? [Coverage, Gap]

## Performance & Scalability Requirements

- [x] CHK016 - Are performance targets defined for authentication flows (login, token refresh, session validation) with specific thresholds? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK017 - Are search performance requirements specified under concurrent load or for large result sets beyond the "past week" scope? [Completeness, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK018 - Are degradation requirements defined when the system approaches resource limits on a minimal VPS (1GB RAM, 1 vCPU)? [Edge Case, Gap, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK019 - Is "significant performance degradation" in SC-003 quantified with measurable thresholds (e.g., latency increase %, error rate)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK020 - Are performance requirements consistent between plan (sub-200ms p95 API latency) and spec success criteria (SC-002 sub-2s messaging)? [Consistency, Plan §Performance Goals vs Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK021 - Are file upload performance requirements defined for the 100MB maximum (not just 10MB in SC-006)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010 vs §SC-006]
- [x] CHK022 - Are notification delivery latency requirements defined under high event volume (many concurrent mentions/assignments)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK023 - Are real-time messaging performance requirements specified for concurrent active users (50 per org)? [Completeness, Spec §SC-003]

## Cross-Cutting: Auth + Tenancy + Performance

- [x] CHK024 - Are permission change propagation requirements defined (how quickly revoked permissions take effect across active sessions)? [Completeness, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 - Are requirements for handling permission changes on active user sessions specified (e.g., immediate revocation vs. grace period)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK026 - Is the relationship between OIDC identity provider and organization membership clearly defined (can one OIDC user belong to multiple orgs)? [Clarity, Gap]
- [x] CHK027 - Are concurrent session limits per user specified, and are requirements for session invalidation across devices defined? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK028 - Are data retention requirements for soft-deleted content consistent with performance implications (e.g., large deleted message volumes affecting search)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK029 - Is the assumption that Zitadel is always available validated with fallback requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK030 - Are external dependency requirements (Valkey for pub/sub, Meilisearch for search) specified with failure behavior expectations? [Dependency, Gap]
- [x] CHK031 - Is the assumption of "stable internet connection" for real-time features reconciled with offline or degraded-network requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK032 - Does "customizable role-based access control with granular permissions" (FR-005) define the scope of configurability (org-level vs. workspace-level)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK033 - Is "comprehensive in-app notifications" (FR-012) quantified with specific notification types and delivery guarantees? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK034 - Do the success criteria (sub-2s messaging) and plan performance goals (sub-200ms p95) conflict or complement each other without resolution? [Conflict, Spec §SC-002 vs Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK035 - Are "organization-configurable retention periods" (FR-014) bounded with minimum/maximum values to prevent performance degradation? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Focus areas for this checklist: multi-tenancy isolation, authentication/OIDC, performance/scalability
- Generated as pre-implementation sanity check (author-facing)
